paragraphs: SwiftComply sells compliance management software for water, wastewater, and stormwater utilities, covering Backflow Prevention, Stormwater, Industrial Pretreatment, and FOG management. It replaces spreadsheet and paper based compliance tracking with one system for reporting, follow-up, and enforcement. Live dashboards show compliance rates, outstanding items, and trends across programs. Every inspection, report, and follow-up is timestamped and stored for a state audit or permit review.

These pages say the software is used by municipal water and wastewater utilities, public works departments, and water/sewer districts. Named customers include cities and counties such as Houston, Atlanta, Fort Worth, Charlotte Water, Dallas, Tampa, and Honolulu. The pages say 700+ organizations across North America run compliance programs on it.

Each solution is priced separately, typically as a one-time implementation fee plus an annual subscription. Backflow programs can also choose a tester-pay model, where a per-test fee is passed to testers instead of the utility funding the subscription. The software is available through cooperative purchasing vehicles such as Omnia Partners, NASPO, and Carahsoft, which many public agencies can use without running a separate competitive bid.
